entries.title: I Samuel 16:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite. For I have provided Myself a king among his sons."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:2
segments: And Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears [it], he will kill me." And the LORD said, "Take a heifer with you, and say, 'I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.'

entries.title: I Samuel 16:3
segments: "Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I name to you."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:4
segments: So Samuel did what the LORD said, and went to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, "Do you come peaceably?"

entries.title: I Samuel 16:5
segments: And he said, "Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons, and invited them to the sacrifice.

entries.title: I Samuel 16:6
segments: ¶So it was, when they came, that he looked at Eliab and said, "Surely the LORD'S anointed [is] before Him."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:7
segments: But the LORD said to Samuel, "Do not look at his appearance or at the height of his stature, because I have refused him. For [the LORD does] not [see] as man sees; for man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:8
segments: So Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, "Neither has the LORD chosen this one."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:9
segments: Then Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, "Neither has the LORD chosen this one."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:10
segments: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, "The LORD has not chosen these."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:11
segments: And Samuel said to Jesse, "Are all the young men here?" Then he said, "There remains yet the youngest, and there he is, keeping the sheep." And Samuel said to Jesse, "Send and bring him. For we will not sit down till he comes here."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:12
segments: So he sent and brought him in. Now he [was] ruddy, with bright eyes, and good-looking. And the LORD said, "Arise, anoint him; for this [is] the one!"

entries.title: I Samuel 16:13
segments: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers; and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel arose and went to Ramah.

entries.title: I Samuel 16:14
segments: ¶But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and a distressing spirit from the LORD troubled him.

entries.title: I Samuel 16:15
segments: And Saul's servants said to him, "Surely, a distressing spirit from God is troubling you.

entries.title: I Samuel 16:16
segments: "Let our master now command your servants, [who are] before you, to seek out a man [who is] a skillful player on the harp; and it shall be that he will play it with his hand when the distressing spirit from God is upon you, and you shall be well."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:17
segments: So Saul said to his servants, "Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring [him] to me."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:18
segments: Then one of the servants answered and said, "Look, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, [who is] skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the LORD [is] with him."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:19
segments: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, "Send me your son David, who [is] with the sheep."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:20
segments: And Jesse took a donkey [loaded with] bread, a skin of wine, and a young goat, and sent [them] by his son David to Saul.

entries.title: I Samuel 16:21
segments: So David came to Saul and stood before him. And he loved him greatly, and he became his armorbearer.

entries.title: I Samuel 16:22
segments: Then Saul sent to Jesse, saying, "Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight."

entries.title: I Samuel 16:23
segments: And so it was, whenever the spirit from God was upon Saul, that David would take a harp and play [it] with his hand. Then Saul would become refreshed and well, and the distressing spirit would depart from him.
